postings.title: Account Executive - SMB Sales
postings.description:
At WorkWave, we build innovative software and fintech solutions for the people who keep our world safe, clean, and beautiful, from pest control to lawn care, commercial cleaning to security services. With over 8,000 customers around the globe, our platform helps these hardworking service professionals run and grow their businesses from end to end:  from customer acquisition to scheduling, billing, payments, and beyond.
 
Our vision is simple but powerful: empower the world’s mobile service workers to build a brighter future. And we back that up with decades of experience, a passionate team, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers thrive.
 
WorkWave is seeking a results‑driven Account Executive to focus on small and growing Pest and Lawn service businesses. This role is ideal for a motivated sales professional who is eager to build strong relationships, master a consultative sales process, and help entrepreneurs transform the way they run and grow their service businesses.
 
Why Join Now:
We’re at an exciting moment in our growth journey. With the launch of Wavelytics, our new AI-powered analytics suite, and continued momentum in integrated payments, we’re unlocking new ways to deliver value to our customers, and new opportunities for our team. WorkWave operates in a field service management market that’s accelerating due to global trends in automation, sustainability, and digital transformation. Joining now means getting in early as we scale to meet massive demand and lead the future of service software.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:
- Learn quickly and build a strong understanding of our platform and its value for small, growing Pest and Lawn service businesses with 4-9 employees

- Lead online demos that excite and inspire stakeholders to envision a future state that drives growth, efficiency, and digital transformation

- Own your territory like a “CEO”. Manage the sales cycle from lead generation to closing with a hunter mentality that balances a consistent cadence of outbound activity and a quick response to inbound MQLs

- Master the sales process - conducting discovery, scoping, and proof of concept to create a seamless experience for prospects

- Leverage best‑in‑class tools like Salesforce, SalesLoft, and 6Sense to manage activity, build accurate forecasts, and a strong predictable pipeline

- Stay focused on results - hitting weekly KPIs (demos booked, demos held, 3x pipeline) and closing deals every week to exceed quota

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
- The ability to take initiative and work independently, confidently manage your pipeline, prospect proactively, lead demos that inspire, and close deals efficiently

- Strong communication skills that combine active listening, thoughtful negotiation, and consultative selling to connect with and influence stakeholders

- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple deals at once and manage quick turnarounds without missing a beat

- A positive, can-do attitude with a natural talent for building authentic relationships and earning trust quickly

- 1-3 years of experience in a closing sales role within SMB markets

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a SaaS SMB Account Executive role

- Must be within a commutable distance to our Holmdel, NJ office

WHAT YOU SHOULD KNOW ABOUT US:  
• We are laid back but buttoned up. We offer a casual work environment and remote work flexibility and have a passion for developing creative, innovative best in class solutions that directly contribute to the success of our customers
• We care deeply and deliver service and solutions that make a real difference in the lives of our clients and their businesses
• We openly accept others as they are and build strong partnerships based on trust
• Teamwork and collaboration is key to help our colleagues and customers solve their challenges
• Our team is energetic, fun, naturally inquisitive and eager to make an impact, we invite you to join us! 
 
LOVE WHAT YOU DO, NO MATTER WHERE YOU DO IT: 
• Join our Remote-First Global Work Community: WorkWave provides an innovative and dynamic remote-first Global Work Community that encourages growth, creativity, and collaboration. No matter what stage of your career or where you live, WorkWave is your place to be part of a global company with a startup feel, where your ideas matter and your growth is a priority. 
 
A GLOBAL COMPANY WITH A LOCAL PRESENCE:
 • We know that there are benefits of being in the office and working from home. WorkWave promotes a healthy work/life balance and provides employees with the flexibility of collaborating in the office or the option to work virtually if desired. Our teams are well versed at working collaboratively in a fully virtual environment.   
• Our HQ is based at our state of the art home office in the historic Bell Works complex located in Holmdel Township, New Jersey. We keep our offices available to all to use when working remotely isn’t feasible, or to help with cross training, team building and/or brainstorming. 
• We have employees in over 30 states, 7 countries and many regional offices - each with their own set of perks and opportunities to give back to the local community.  
• Whether you work remotely or take advantage of one of our offices, you’ll find a community of WorkWavers that value diversity, and care deeply about our products, clients, our communities and each other.
 
RELAX, WE'VE GOT YOU COVERED:

AND BEYOND...

• Tuition reimbursement
• Robust Employee Assistance Program through TotalCare offering free counseling 24/7/365, plus financial counseling, legal guidance, adoption assistance services and much more!

GROW WITH US:

postings.title: AI Quality Governance Engineer (QGE)  M/F
postings.description:
WorkWave is a leading provider of cloud-based software that supports every stage of a service business's life cycle—from lead management and CRM to scheduling, routing, field operations, and payment facilitation. Our core platforms (PestPac, RealGreen, WinTeam, and TimeGate) serve pest control, lawn and landscape, security, and commercial cleaning companies, from multi-billion-dollar enterprises to the smallest upstart seeking an edge


About the Role
At WorkWave, we treat quality as an engineering discipline, not an inspection checklist. The AI Quality Governance Engineer (QGE) combines technical automation development with high-impact quality governance:

- 

Engineering: Build scalable automated systems. Write clean test code, set up CI/CD quality gates, and create AI utilities (test skeleton generators, risk-scoring models, auto-triage pipelines).

- 

Governance: Define "Done" across internal and vendor teams (such as Virtusa), enforce release standards, and track metrics that reflect actual system health (Change Failure Rate, Defect Escape Rate).

- 

Day-One AI Fluency: AI is integrated directly into daily work. You will use AI pair-programming tools to draft tests and automation scripts, applying engineering judgment to ensure full coverage and edge-case validation.

Key Responsibilities

- 

Automation & CI/CD (≈40%): Write and maintain end-to-end and API automation using Playwright, UnifiedDriver, and BDD frameworks. Configure automated gates in GitHub Actions to block regressions without slowing deployment.

- 

AI Tooling & Innovation (≈40%): Pair with AI assistants (Claude, GitHub Copilot) to draft test suites, design reusable prompt templates, and build internal tools like the Quality Radar risk-prediction model.

- 

Governance & Standards (≈20%): Define quality gates across SDLC checkpoints, audit contractor deliverables, monitor DORA metrics, and partner with Engineering Managers during sprint planning to address testability gaps.

Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent (Contratto a Tempo Indeterminato)

Level / Inquadramento: Mid-Level Livello B2 (CCNL Metalmeccanico PMI Confimi agreement)

Department: Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (COE)

Reports To: Director of Quality / Functional QA Manager

Candidate Profile
Technical & AI Skills (Must Have)

- 

3+ years in software quality engineering with a focus on automation.

- 

Working proficiency in at least one modern language: TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Python, or Java (.NET/C# or TypeScript preferred).

- 

Hands-on experience with modern test frameworks (Playwright, Selenium, or RestAssured for APIs).

- 

Experience reading and configuring GitHub Actions YAML workflows.

- 

AI-First Mindset: Daily experience using tools like Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test writing, with the critical judgment to detect thin coverage or hallucinations before committing to source control.

- 

Working knowledge of DORA quality metrics (Change Failure Rate, MTTR, Escape Rate).

Nice to Have

- 

ISTQB certification (CT-AI or CT-TAE).

- 

Experience establishing quality gates for offshore/outsourced technical partners.

- 

Familiarity with SaaS enterprise software (e.g., field service management, ERP, scheduling).

- 

Professional working proficiency in English (for global technical architecture); Italian language skills for local Verona hub collaboration.

Equal Opportunity & Non-Discrimination Statement
WorkWave is an equal opportunity employer and evaluates applications without discrimination, in compliance with Italian law (Legislative Decrees 198/2006, 215/2003 and 216/2003). 
Targeted Placement Priority (Legge 68/1999)
Applications from candidates registered in the ‘collocamento mirato’ lists (Italian Law 68/1999) are welcome and will be given priority, all other requirements being equal. (M/F)
Candidate Privacy Notice (GDPR & D.Lgs. 196/2003)
Candidates are invited to read the Privacy Policy pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Italian Legislative Decree 196/2003 (as amended by D.Lgs. 101/2018). Categories of Data & Protected Categories (Italian Law 68/1999):  We process contact details, work history, education, qualifications, and any information provided in your CV and recruitment correspondence. We do not solicit special-category (sensitive) data, except where strictly necessary to confirm eligibility for Protected Categories under Italian Law 12 March 1999, no. 68 (targeted disability and quota hiring) or to provide reasonable accommodations during interviews. 
Access control: Documentation concerning Law 68/1999 is accessible solely to authorized HR/compliance personnel and is kept segregated from technical interviewers and hiring managers. 
Data is handled by authorized internal personnel and third-party recruitment/ATS vendors appointed as Data Processors (Art. 28 GDPR). Any data transfers outside the European Economic Area (EEA) rely on valid transfer mechanisms under Chapter V of the GDPR (e.g., EU Adequacy Decisions or EU Standard Contractual Clauses).

postings.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Platform
postings.description:
We are looking for a product-minded AI engineer to turn what our customers are trying to decide into agents they actually rely on. AskWaive, our in-product assistant, is already live; the work now is quality, coverage, and an experience that wows.

This is not a role for a prompt author or a demo builder. We want an owner: someone who takes a customer need—already expressed through our serving layers and semantic layer—and turns it into an endpoint, a tool, and an experience that makes the customer measurably better at their job. Agent engineering, deployment, and testing are all part of delivery, not a handoff.

Our core data platform is owned by the team that built it. You'll build on top of it—and where data or infrastructure is holding an agent back, you'll have the standing to propose the change and drive it.

What You'll Do 
From Customer Need to Product Superpower

- 

Own the Outcome: Start from the customer, and stay with it until the agent is answering their needs better

- 

Build Agents and Tools: Build production agents and the tools they call—retrieval, multi-step workflows, action-taking—on Amazon Bedrock, with Bedrock AgentCore as our runtime and tools exposed over MCP (Model Context Protocol).

- 

Turn Serving Layers Into Capability: Our semantic layer and service APIs are where customer needs are already expressed. Your job is turning them into endpoints and tools an agent can wield well—and knowing which metrics and entities it should reach at all.

- 

Shape the Experience, Not Just the Endpoint: How an answer arrives—its speed, its confidence, its explanation, the next step it offers—is the product. A technically correct response a customer ignores is a failure.

Prove It and Make It Felt

- 

Measure Groundedness: Build the eval harness—labeled test sets, groundedness and hallucination rates you can put a number on, and CI gates that stop a regression before it ships.

- 

Measure What Customers Got: Adoption, feedback, intent—then report realized impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up.

- 

Diagnose and Iterate: Instrument the tracing that shows why an answer was wrong, turn each failure mode into a specific fix, and ship again. This loop is the job, not a phase of it.

Deliver

- 

Ship and Operate: Own the serving path—MCP endpoints, latency, cost per response, caching, and runtime guardrails. Deployment and testing are part of the job, not a handoff.

- 

Embed and Influence: Partner with Product Managers and engineers on which decisions an agent should support—and which it shouldn't. Where data or infrastructure limits what an agent can do, drive the change alongside the team that owns the platform.

Who You Are 
The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions with the agent's help, not by whether it shipped.

The Agent Builder: You've taken an agent past the demo. You know the hard part is everything after it works once—coverage, grounding, cost, and the failure modes you only see at scale. You fix problems without waiting for a ticket.

The Experience Obsessive: You care how an answer lands, not just whether it was right. Trustworthy, fast, and legible beats clever.

We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you are a builder who cares about the "why" behind the code, we want to hear from you!

HOW WE WORK

We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next task faster for the whole team. The leverage is in the verification: the tests, CI gates, and typed interfaces that make agent-written code safe to merge.

What You"ll Bring 
- 

Experience: 5+ years building production software or data-intensive systems used by real customers, with strong Python skills—including at least one LLM or agent feature you shipped to production users.

- 

AWS & Agent Stack: Hands-on AWS experience, ideally Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore. Equivalent agent runtimes transfer, but we build on AWS and you'll be productive faster if you have prior exposure.

- 

Agent Engineering: Orchestration, tool and function design, context assembly, and multi-step workflows—you've made the design calls, not just the prompt calls.

- 

Retrieval & Domain Grounding: You've built retrieval over real business data, you can explain how context gets selected and why an answer was wrong, and you have enough SQL and metric fluency to catch an agent answering with the wrong number.

- 

Evaluation & Iteration: You've built or owned an eval loop for a generative system—labelled sets, regression gates, and a number you could defend when someone asked whether it got better.

- 

Product Sense for AI: You have opinions about how an agent should behave—when to answer, when to ask, when to refuse, how to show its work—and you've shipped those opinions, not just argued them.

- 

Measurement & Narrative: You've quantified what an agent actually delivered for users—adoption, task success, decision quality—and presented it to people who were never going to read your traces.

- 

Working With Agents: You've used coding agents on real production work, you can tell correct output from merely plausible output, and you invest in the harnesses that make the next task faster.

- 

Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working across technical and non-technical teams.

Bonus Points For:

- 

LLM observability tooling (Langfuse, LangSmith, or Arize).

- 

Semantic layer or metrics-layer design (Ossie, dbt).

- 

Field-service, logistics, or other operational SaaS domains.

- 

Prior experience as a senior or lead engineer responsible for guiding technical direction.

Location: Remote (UK-based) with occasional collaborative team meetups.

Right to Work: Applicants must currently have the legal right to work in the UK. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

postings.title: Senior Applied Data Scientist / ML Engineer
postings.description:
We are looking for a product-minded applied data scientist or engineer to turn raw operational data into products that measurably improve how our customers make decisions and run their businesses. Which label you carry matters less to us than whether customers end up better off.

This is not a research-only role, nor a service-oriented internal analytics position—and it is not a role for a model builder alone. We want an owner: someone who frames the problem, learns the domain, builds the data when it doesn't exist, ships the model, and stays with it until customers are acting on it and can measure the reward. The road runs through data engineering; deployment and testing are part of delivery, not a handoff. You understand that great models are not just accurate in notebooks—they are usable, explainable, and measurable inside a real product.

Whether you came to this work through statistics, software, analytics, or data engineering, you have a strong bias toward shipping.

What You'll Do 
From Raw Data to Better Decisions

- 

Own the Outcome: Take an ambiguous customer problem, decide whether ML is even the right answer, build it, and stay with it until customers are acting on it.

- 

Learn the Domain: Get fluent in the semantics of how our customers operate—what a route, a crew, or a service history actually means. A model that is accurate but wrong about the domain creates nothing.

- 

Build the Data You Need: When the features don't exist, create them in Snowflake and dbt rather than waiting for someone else to.

Prove It and Make It Felt

- 

Make the Value Legible: Decide how a prediction reaches the customer so they understand it, trust it, and act on it—then report realised impact back to Product and the business in numbers that hold up.

- 

Measure Honestly: Define offline and online evaluation for model quality, drift, and reliability, and design the A/B tests or causal analyses that prove a feature improved customer outcomes.

Deliver

- 

Ship and Operate: Deployment, testing, versioning, monitoring, and drift detection. Delivery is part of the job, not a handoff.

- 

Embed with Product: Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to put ML inside real product workflows—and say clearly when ML isn't the answer.

Who We Are 
- 

The Owner: You measure your work by whether customers made better decisions, not by whether the model shipped.

- 

Closer to the Data and the Customer: You'd rather spend a week understanding what the data means than a week tuning a model. You know the domain is the hard part.

- 

A Multi-Disciplinary Operator: You'll chase down the data yourself when it isn't ready, and build the pipeline if that's what delivery requires. You prioritise usability, "Time to Insight," and customer trust as much as you do code efficiency.

We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. If you have shipped a model you are proud of, we want to hear from you!

HOW WE WORK

We build with coding agents. You set direction and targets, review output critically, and build the harnesses—scaffolding, context, tests, review loops—that make the next model faster to ship. The leverage is in the verification: the backtests, eval scaffolding, and data checks that make generated work safe to trust.

What You'll Bring 
- 

Experience: 5+ years in applied data science, ML engineering, or data engineering that included owning models in production—including at least one model you built and shipped into a real product. B2B SaaS experience is a strong plus.

- 

Technical Core: Strong Python and applied ML libraries for tabular problems (scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, statsmodels or Prophet). Solid SQL expertise is required.

- 

ML & Modeling Depth: Depth in supervised learning, forecasting, ranking, recommendation, or optimisation. You have modelled messy operational data, not benchmark datasets.

- 

Data & Delivery: You build the data you need and ship what you build—dbt and Snowflake modelling, feature pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and drift detection. We're on AWS.

- 

Measurement & Narrative: You've quantified the business impact of a model you shipped—adoption, outcome, ROI—and presented it to people who were never going to read your notebook.

- 

Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to product, engineering, and non-technical business stakeholders.

Bonus Points For:

- 

Working With Agents: You've used coding agents on real modelling or engineering work, you can tell correct output from merely plausible output, and you invest in the scaffolding that makes the next model faster to ship.

- 

Decision Intelligence: Experience with decision intelligence, forecasting, customer behaviour modelling, workforce/route optimisation, or operational intelligence products.

- 

Leadership: Prior experience as a senior or lead scientist or engineer responsible for guiding technical direction.

- 

LLM / Agentic AI: LLM or agentic workflows shipped into a product.

LOCATION & RIGHT TO WORK

- 

Location: Remote (UK-based) with flexible working options.

- 

Right to Work: Applicants must currently have the legal right to work in the UK. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship now or in the future for this position.

postings.title: Senior Software Architect (M/F)
postings.description:
WorkWave is a leading provider of cloud-based software that supports every stage of a service business's life cycle—from lead management and CRM to scheduling, routing, field operations, and payment facilitation. Our core platforms (PestPac, RealGreen, WinTeam, and TimeGate) serve pest control, lawn and landscape, security, and commercial cleaning companies, from multi-billion-dollar enterprises to the smallest upstart seeking an edge.


The Role 
We are seeking a Senior Software Architect who thrives on technical variety and architectural impact. In this role, you will not be confined to a single silo; you will work across domains, platforms, tech stacks, and architectures. You will lead initiatives spanning legacy platform modernization, cloud-native shared service design, and the deployment of production-grade AI agents.

As a hands-on technical leader, you will design systems, build reference implementations, mentor engineers, and set the technical bar across our engineering organization. You will also work in direct collaboration with our enterprise customers to understand operational complexities and architect robust technical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

- 

Platform Architecture & Roadmap: Own the architecture for one or more core WorkWave platforms and shared services; define technical roadmaps, architectural standards, technical debt mitigation strategies, and cross-portfolio alignment.

- 

Enterprise Discovery & Solutions: Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand their workflows, lead technical discovery, and design scalable integration and architecture solutions.

- 

Multi-Domain Technical Breadth: Drive architecture across diverse service domains (scheduling, routing, payments, telematics, ERP, and payroll) leveraging modern tech stacks including C#/.NET (8–10), Python/FastAPI, Node/TypeScript, and modern front-end frameworks.

- 

Incremental Modernization: Lead legacy extraction programs, safely migrating embedded business logic and stored procedures into modern, event-driven, API-first services without operational downtime.

- 

Shared Services & Integration: Design re-usable, plug-and-play services capable of integrating seamlessly into PestPac, RealGreen, WinTeam, and TimeGate.

- 

Cloud & Infrastructure Leadership (AWS): Lead cloud platform evolution on AWS utilizing containerization (EKS/Kubernetes), serverless patterns (Lambda, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, DynamoDB), managed databases (Aurora, PostgreSQL), and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

- 

AI & Agentic Systems: Architect and deploy production-grade AI systems, including multi-agent assistants, tool orchestration, human-in-the-loop workflows, evaluation frameworks, security boundaries, and token cost governance.

- 

Data Tier Architecture: Design high-performance, multi-tenant database architectures across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MySQL at scale.

- 

Prototypes & Decision Science: Execute architectural spikes and proof-of-concepts (POCs) to evaluate trade-offs, backing decisions with rigorous empirical data.

- 

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship: Drive architecture review practices, security-by-design, CI/CD automation, and modern testing standards. Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through pairing, design coaching, and internal tech sessions.

Location: Verona, Italy (Remote / Smart Working options available)

Contract Type: Full-time, Permanent (Contratto a Tempo Indeterminato)

Level / Inquadramento: Livello Quadro (B3) (CCNL Metalmeccanico PMI Confimi agreement)

What You'll Need 
- 

Education & Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (Laurea Magistrale / Specialistica) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent professional experience.

- 

Professional Experience: 8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale distributed SaaS platforms.

- 

Polyglot & Architectural Depth: Expert-level proficiency in C# / .NET (Core / .NET ), alongside working proficiency in Python, TypeScript/Node, Java, or Go. Demonstrated ability to ramp up rapidly in unfamiliar codebases.

- 

Cloud Architecture: Deep experience with AWS (preferred) or Azure architectures—including Kubernetes/containers, serverless, messaging, and managed data services.

- 

Data Systems: Advanced SQL expertise (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) with demonstrated query tuning at high concurrency, paired with practical NoSQL experience (e.g., DynamoDB).

- 

Distributed Systems: Strong grounding in Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), microservices, and multi-tenant SaaS architecture.

- 

AI / Emerging Tech: Practical experience or strong proven aptitude in building production LLM/agentic workflows and utilizing AI-assisted software development practices.

- 

Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills in English (written and verbal), with the ability to articulate trade-offs across executive, engineering, and enterprise customer audiences. A collaborative, low-ego leadership mindset.

Equal Opportunity & Non-Discrimination Statement
WorkWave is an equal opportunity employer and evaluates applications without discrimination, in compliance with Italian law (Legislative Decrees 198/2006, 215/2003 and 216/2003). 
Targeted Placement Priority (Legge 68/1999)
Applications from candidates registered in the ‘collocamento mirato’ lists (Italian Law 68/1999) are welcome and will be given priority, all other requirements being equal. (M/F)
Candidate Privacy Notice (GDPR & D.Lgs. 196/2003)
Candidates are invited to read the Privacy Policy pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Italian Legislative Decree 196/2003 (as amended by D.Lgs. 101/2018). Categories of Data & Protected Categories (Italian Law 68/1999):  We process contact details, work history, education, qualifications, and any information provided in your CV and recruitment correspondence. We do not solicit special-category (sensitive) data, except where strictly necessary to confirm eligibility for Protected Categories under Italian Law 12 March 1999, no. 68 (targeted disability and quota hiring) or to provide reasonable accommodations during interviews. 
Access control: Documentation concerning Law 68/1999 is accessible solely to authorized HR/compliance personnel and is kept segregated from technical interviewers and hiring managers. 
Data is handled by authorized internal personnel and third-party recruitment/ATS vendors appointed as Data Processors (Art. 28 GDPR). Any data transfers outside the European Economic Area (EEA) rely on valid transfer mechanisms under Chapter V of the GDPR (e.g., EU Adequacy Decisions or EU Standard Contractual Clauses).
